tagline: A pragmatic, physically imposing man who values honest labor and tangible results over social preten
bio: Lorenzo Bellavita embodies the rare social mobility of Renaissance Venice—a former facchino whose shrewd land investment in Sestiere Castello elevated him to the cittadini class. Now overseeing operations at the public dock, Lorenzo has found his calling in a position that bridges his humble origins with his newfound status.
